message:
test(e2e): e2e_job_run -- the AVD bundle's fixture in a verified kill-on-close job of its own, so nothing it starts outlives the bundle (keepalive-r2 e, Codex avd_guard r2 G2)

The fixture supervises its own children, but a fixture that crashed or was killed left them running
(a parent's end is not its children's). e2e_job_run makes a job, reads its KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE back,
creates the command SUSPENDED, assigns it, checks IsProcessInJob and only then resumes it -- so it
can start nothing outside. Once the stop file exists the command gets its grace, then the whole job
is terminated (forced); whatever is left when the command ends (its descendants) is terminated
(residual); the end is confirmed by the job's active count reaching 0. One line says it all; the
exit code is the command's only when nothing had to be forced and the end was confirmed. Killing
the runner itself closes the job: kill-on-close ends the rest. Nothing outside its own job is
touched. Test tooling, never packaged.
